final: WITH customer_counts AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.gender) <> '' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender), shares AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (PARTITION BY gender), 0) AS share FROM customer_counts), gaps AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, order_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average FROM shares) SELECT customer_id, gender, order_count, share, above_average FROM gaps WHERE above_average > 0 ORDER BY above_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
